components:
Create ONE square UI component reference sheet for retro pixel dachshund snake game, matching attached visual reference style and palette exactly: dark navy, jade thin pixel borders, ivory bitmap text, warm gold pointer, caramel-brown dog. Logical 240px style enlarged. Humble playable arcade UI, no fine illustration, no fancy ornaments. Revise the previous too-symbolic interface to understandable icon+SHORT CHINESE LABEL design.
Neatly spaced 5 rows, readable. Row1 exact gameplay HUD: "ROUND 2" at left, ivory bone icon "3/5" center, trophy icon "15" right. No stage lights or numbered badges.
Row2 selected menu row small play triangle + "开始游戏", below unselected row small question mark + "玩法说明". Clear selected gold pointer, jade outline. These are MENU ROWS not touchscreen giant tiles.
Row3 four compact samples in 2x2: play icon "继续游戏", exit icon "退出游戏", retry arrow "再来一局", back arrow "返回". Every action labelled.
Row4 icons bone, trophy, fan-ribbed scallop SHELL, pause; below four compact reward variants 0stars shell5 /1star shell10 /2stars shell20 /3stars shell30. Do not use coins.
Row5 small physical key hint badges "A 选择" "B 确定" "C 返回". Small footer countdown numerals3 2 1.
No other text or sample stage lights. Keep labels crisp accurately spelled Chinese and consistent bitmap type. Use supporting familiar symbols but never replace meaningful action labels with ambiguous icons alone.
correction: Top-left header must read exactly ROUND 2 instead of 第2关.
